scope: Shared Slang smoke-grid, geometry-smoke and fluid-smoke schedules executed through the public Vulkan driver and common Gallery session

advertised_interactions: smoke self pressure and viscosity for particle and grid profiles
smoke-rigid-body contact and drag for particle and grid profiles
fluid-smoke drag, thermal exchange and phase transfer for particle and grid profiles
contract.catalog_policy: A scene is selectable only when the physical device advertises every exact interaction key required by that scene.

transport.workgroup_shape: Smoke entry points use the same specialization-controlled workgroup size as the portable scheduler launch.
transport.entry_parameters: Modules whose reflected entry block exceeds 256 bytes use dynamic uniform-buffer binding 1. Existing modules retain their qualified push-constant layout.
transport.physics_source: Existing common Slang modules; Vulkan adds reflected transport only.
